title: Lacson questions motive behind 3 minority senators' votes on motion to unseat Tulfo
summary: Sen. Panfilo Lacson on Saturday questioned the motive behind the vote of 3 minority senator-members on a motion to disqualify Sen. Erwin Tulfo through the Senate Electoral Tribunal (SET).
